leadText:
Ralph (Japanese: サスケ Sasuke) is a character of the day who appeared in Ariados, Amigos. He is a student at the Pokémon Jujitsu Academy.

Ralph took the Red classes of the Academy which studies battle techniques. He battled Mickey and won.
